I found two critical problems, both on line 8 of `src/support-bot.js`. The system prompt contains the support console password, and it tells the model to decide who is a support agent. I haven't quoted the password anywhere below. The model client in `src/model-client.js` currently returns a fixed reply and sends nothing anywhere, so neither problem can be exploited through the chat today. The password is still written in the source code. Overall confidence is LOW: I couldn't read the method file or run the search for hidden characters (details under limitations). The model-technique identifiers were looked up live (MITRE ATLAS release 2026.09).
